title: Hinomori Shiho — Technical Expert〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day of the solo show
Live House

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We've finished the sound check and all our instruments are ready to go.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (All that's left is for the doors to open to let the crowd in...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's almost time...
Our very first solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Hm? Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: The doors open soon. Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I just wanted to take one last look at this place before we let everyone in.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wanted to take a moment to appreciate it... That we're doing a solo show here.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
It's like the calm before the storm, right?
That strange lull before the doors open.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Yeah, and you only get the chance to feel it before everyone's allowed in.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Let us know if anything sounds funny to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I appreciate it.
But everything sounded okay during our rehearsal, so I'm sure everything is working just fine.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Speaking of which, the lighting and effects sheet was filled out so thoroughly. It made things so much easier.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Did you write all that, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, that was Honami.
Actually, she took care of most of the paperwork for us this time...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
She did?
Hehe. You sound like pros already...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Especially how you sounded during your rehearsal just now. I'm looking forward to seeing the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, hello...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
We have a big line outside...
I think it's about time we let them in.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
Again, thank you all for your help.

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
No problem!
Now, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Let's open the doors!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa...! I come here a lot to see shows, but things feel different today for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: That's because it's Leo/need's very first solo show! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (There's a lot of people filing in...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I was pretty sure that we sold enough tickets, but seeing them all here does take a load off my mind...)

rows.Speaker: Band Members
rows.Line: Shiho! We're looking forward to seeing the show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
Thank you all for coming.

rows.Speaker: Band Members
rows.Line:
We weren't going to miss this!
Not after how much you've helped us!

rows.Speaker: Band Members
rows.Line: We've been rooting for you ever since we heard that you formed your own band. So, we can't wait to see today's show!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you. We promise to do our best.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: There's a nice vibe going, isn't there?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, Iori, hello.
I didn't realize you were also here.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Of course I'm here. I mean, a lot did happen between us.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe how fast things have changed...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Not too long ago, I was trying to get you to join my band, but you're putting on your very own solo show now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I sort of can't believe it either.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, Ichika and the others have shown me just how serious they are by working incredibly hard.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You girls really have really become a great band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Now, you just need to produce some good results.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. As we are now, we should be able to exceed everyone's expectations.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'll be looking forward to that.
For now, see you later.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're all looking forward to seeing our show...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Normally, people would get nervous or feel pressured during this time... But...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can't wait to start playing...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wanna put on the best show ever and totally blow everyone away...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I think we... No, I know we can do it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So, let's go out there and have some fun!)
